name: Water Release: Sensing Rain Tiger Sphere

system.description:
You collect a mass of water into a sphere from the surrounding area 5 feet in diameter. For the duration of this jutsu you can see movement and activity in a 500-foot radius centering on the sphere. This requires the creature who is moving, to disrupt some source of water (Puddles, bodies of water or rain).

This movement or activity creates bubbles inside the sphere relative to the direction of the movement compared to the location of the sphere. If this jutsu is cast while it is raining, its affected radius becomes the size of the area affected by rainfall.

If used near a sufficient source of water, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can choose to remove Concentration from this jutsu. But if you do, the sphere remains in place and cannot be moved.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you create rain clouds centering on a point you can see up to 1 mile in the air that spreads and covers a 10-mile radius centering on that point. The rain clouds begin to pour down heavy rain lasting for up to 24 hours. For this duration, you subconsciously gain the benefit of this jutsu’s original effect without the need for a sphere of water.
